sn4.19:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā bhikkhū nibbāna-paṭisamyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti || ||
sn4.19:1.3: Te ca bhikkhu aṭṭhi-katvā manasi katvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti || || 2.
sn4.19:2.1: Atha kho Mārassa pāpimato etad ahosi ||
sn4.19:2.2: Ayaṃ kho samaṇo Gotamo bhikkhū nibbāna-paṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya || pa || Yaṃ
sn4.19:2.3: nūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo Gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyam vicakkhukammāyā ti || || 3.
sn4.19:2.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā kassaka-vaṇṇam abhinimminitvā mahantam naṅgalaṃ khandhe karitvā dīgham pācanayaṭṭhiṃ gahetvā haṭa-haṭa-keso sāṇasāṭī-nivattho kaddama-makkhitehi pādehi yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 4.
sn4.19:2.6: Kim pana pāpima te balivaddehī ti || || 6.
sn4.19:2.7: Mam-eva samaṇa cakkhu mama rupā mama cakkhusamphassa-viññānāyatanam ||
sn4.19:2.9: Mam-eva samaṇa saddā sotam mama saddā || pa ||
sn4.19:2.13: Mam-eva samaṇa mano mama dhammā mama manosamphassa-viññāṇāyatanaṃ ||
sn4.19:2.14: kuhim me samaṇa gantvā mokkhasī ti || || 7.
sn4.19:3.1: Tav-eva pāpima cakkhu tava rūpā tava cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇāyatanaṃ ||
sn4.19:3.2: yattha ca kho pāpima natthi cakkhu natthi rūpā natthi cakkhu samphassa-viññāṇāyatanaṃ agati tava tattha pāpima || || 8.
sn4.19:3.3: Tav-eva pāpima sotaṃ tava saddā tava sota-samphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ ||
sn4.19:3.4: yattha ca kho pāpima natthi sotaṃ natthi saddā natthi sota-samphassa-viññāṇāyatanam agati tava tattha pāpima || || 9.
sn4.19:3.5: Tav-eva pāpima ghāṇam tava gandhā tava ghāṇa sampassa-viññāṇāyatanaṃ ||
sn4.19:3.6: yattha ca kho pāpima natthi ghāṇam natthi gandhā natthi ghāṇa-samphassa-viññāṇāyatanam agati tava tattha pāpima || || 10.
sn4.19:3.7: Tav-eva pāpima jivhā tava rasā tava jivhā-samphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ || pa ||
sn4.19:3.8: Tav-eva pāpima kāyo tava phoṭṭhabbā tava kāya-samphassa-viññāṇāyatanaṃ || pa || 11.
sn4.19:3.9: Tav-eva pāpima mano tava dhammā tava manosamphassa-viññāṇāyatanaṃ ||
sn4.19:3.10: yattha ca kho pāpima natthi mano natthi dhammā natthi mano-samphassa-viññāṇāyātanaṃ agati tava tattha papimā ti || || 12.
sn4.19:5.4: na me maggam pi dakkha- sīti || || 14.
sn4.19:6.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || pa || vantaradhāyīti || || 1.
